attackCards.name: Attack declaration cards
attackCards.hint: Single-target attacks first post a chat card (weapon, range, valid targets, MAP, known modifiers) and are resolved from its target buttons or the Sensor Map. Off: the target is picked on the Sensor Map directly.

ruleEnforcement.name: Rule enforcement
ruleEnforcement.hint: Warn: every station rule (helming, grade, malfunction, requirements, frequency, range, detection) is shown as a warning on the chat card and nothing is blocked. Strict: the module refuses the action (the GM can still override).

starshipSheetTheme.name: Starship sheet theme
starshipSheetTheme.hint: Dark or light theme for all player and NPC starship sheets on this client only. Other clients and the Sensor Map are unaffected. No reload required.

edit.abilityHint: Abilities are matched to stations by name (Stations → station actions). Checks written as "DC 20 Will save" or "DC 18 Computers" become clickable automatically.
edit.rawJsonHint: Advanced: the complete starship data. It is validated before saving; Hull Points are taken from hp.
edit.slugHint: Rules data: damage types and traits are entered as system slugs in English (they are displayed translated).

create.title: Create starship
create.hint: Player starships are built from the chosen frame and level; NPC starships and hazards start with level-based placeholder statistics that you can edit on the sheet (Edit tab).

mapAppearance.title: Sensor Map appearance
mapAppearance.objectHint: Choose a map-only image. Leave blank to use the actor portrait (ships/hazards) or the usual symbol. This does not change the actor or token. To place standalone artwork, add a Custom object, then assign its map artwork.
mapAppearance.backgroundHint: Default: opacity 0.35, desaturation 0.25, blur 2 px. Only the background is affected, never labels or artwork. Clear the image path to remove the background. Settings are shared by this combat; only the GM can change them.
mapAppearance.invalidPath: Use a Foundry image path or an HTTP(S) URL.

qol.undoConflict: Undo refused: the ship or encounter state has changed, or this entry is not reversible.
qol.historyFailed: The change was saved, but its history record could not be created.
qol.sustainReminder: Reminder: check whether this effect must be sustained
qol.timingHint: Rounds are relative to now (0 = this round). Several rounds expires at the selected turn start. Arbitrary conditions are confirmed manually. Sustaining only records confirmation; it does not spend actions or extend the duration. A turn start/end that has already passed is scheduled for the next round.
qol.undoHint: Only a narrow set of module changes can be undone, and only if the ship and encounter still match the recorded state. Rolls, actions, critical transitions, initiative, chat and revealed information are not reversed. The latest 80 records are GM whispers; deleting a message removes its record.
qol.entryGone: This object has been removed or its effect has ended. The ship sheet is open.

toolbelt.alreadyApplied: This roll has already been applied to this ship.
toolbelt.mixedTargets: Apply ship damage separately from ordinary actors, or use individual Toolbelt target rows.
toolbelt.useShipShields: Shield Block is for a personal shield. Use Damage through shields or Direct hull damage for a starship.
